related.title: PPP：透明傳輸與轉義成本
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：第5項研究的可複查條件：接受清楚標示邊界的比例；不可直接當TCP應用吞吐保證。 交接時須能核對：交付 layer-budget.csv與1500/9000 B效率比較圖。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Investigation 5 review criterion: Accept ratios only with explicit boundaries; they are not TCP application-throughput guarantees. Handover must also reconcile: Deliver layer-budget.csv and a1500/9000 B efficiency comparison.
related.difference: 逐位元組建立轉義前後對照；此練習假定表頭及FCS沒有額外轉義。
related.differenceEn: Build an octet-level before/after escape map; this fixture assumes headers and FCS need no extra escapes.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice:
IPv6封包長度與Ethernet線上佔用量不同；前導碼及幀間距須按觀測邊界另列。
教學基準：(1500-40)/(1500+14+4+8+12)*100 = 94.9284785436 %；對照：(9000-40)/(9000+14+4+8+12)*100 = 99.1369772073 %。所有數值、事件、期限與門檻是本課明示的合成教學情境，並非官方設備規格、營運網路量測或部署建議。

PPP非同步透明傳輸可轉義特定位元組；壓縮選項會改變框架預算，本題固定不壓縮。
教學基準：1000+2+2+2+2+50 = 1058 B；對照：1000+2+2+2+2+100 = 1108 B。所有數值、事件、期限與門檻是本課明示的合成教學情境，並非官方設備規格、營運網路量測或部署建議。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn:
IPv6 packet size differs from Ethernet wire occupancy; account for preamble and interframe gap at the chosen boundary.
Teaching baseline: (1500-40)/(1500+14+4+8+12)*100 = 94.9284785436 %; comparison: (9000-40)/(9000+14+4+8+12)*100 = 99.1369772073 %. All numeric inputs, events, timers and limits are explicit synthetic teaching conditions, not official equipment specifications, operational-network measurements or deployment recommendations.

Asynchronous PPP transparency escapes selected octets; compression options alter framing, so this fixture disables them.
Teaching baseline: 1000+2+2+2+2+50 = 1058 B; comparison: 1000+2+2+2+2+100 = 1108 B. All numeric inputs, events, timers and limits are explicit synthetic teaching conditions, not official equipment specifications, operational-network measurements or deployment recommendations.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: OSPF：最短路徑樹與故障後重算
related.titleEn: OSPF: shortest-path trees and failure recomputation
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：第5項研究的可複查條件：接受清楚標示邊界的比例；不可直接當TCP應用吞吐保證。 交接時須能核對：交付 layer-budget.csv與1500/9000 B效率比較圖。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Investigation 5 review criterion: Accept ratios only with explicit boundaries; they are not TCP application-throughput guarantees. Handover must also reconcile: Deliver layer-budget.csv and a1500/9000 B efficiency comparison.
related.difference: 建立雙向邊表、Dijkstra暫定距離與前驅表，不把cost當毫秒。
related.differenceEn: Build bidirectional edges, tentative Dijkstra distances and predecessors; cost is not milliseconds.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice:
IPv6封包長度與Ethernet線上佔用量不同；前導碼及幀間距須按觀測邊界另列。
教學基準：(1500-40)/(1500+14+4+8+12)*100 = 94.9284785436 %；對照：(9000-40)/(9000+14+4+8+12)*100 = 99.1369772073 %。所有數值、事件、期限與門檻是本課明示的合成教學情境，並非官方設備規格、營運網路量測或部署建議。

OSPF以鏈路狀態建立最短路徑樹；拓撲變動需要重算，不能沿用舊next hop。
教學基準：min(3+4+5,2+6) = 8 cost；對照：3+4+5 = 12 cost。所有數值、事件、期限與門檻是本課明示的合成教學情境，並非官方設備規格、營運網路量測或部署建議。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn:
IPv6 packet size differs from Ethernet wire occupancy; account for preamble and interframe gap at the chosen boundary.
Teaching baseline: (1500-40)/(1500+14+4+8+12)*100 = 94.9284785436 %; comparison: (9000-40)/(9000+14+4+8+12)*100 = 99.1369772073 %. All numeric inputs, events, timers and limits are explicit synthetic teaching conditions, not official equipment specifications, operational-network measurements or deployment recommendations.

OSPF builds shortest-path trees from link state; topology changes require recomputation rather than reuse of an old next hop.
Teaching baseline: min(3+4+5,2+6) = 8 cost; comparison: 3+4+5 = 12 cost. All numeric inputs, events, timers and limits are explicit synthetic teaching conditions, not official equipment specifications, operational-network measurements or deployment recommendations.
